properties.name: test_specification_ref
properties.description: The TestSpecification (TESTED_BY; ISA-95 Equipment → TestSpecification). Optional.

properties.name: spatial_definition

properties.name: spatial_format

properties.name: element_id
properties.description: Identity of the machine: its i3X element id, the key (kgIdProperty) every machine profile inherits. ISA-95 Equipment.ID; it travels in the signal envelope.

properties.name: Act_Status_Machine
properties.description: Actual machine status (sim node Machine/status, the same on every machine); lifted into SMProfile-Machine in core 6.0.0. Full text: docs/history/standard/profiles/equipment/machine.md, attributes › Act_Status_Machine › description.

properties.name: Act_Mode_Machine
properties.description: Machine operating mode (sim node Machine/mode, the same on every machine); lifted into SMProfile-Machine in core 6.0.0. Full text: docs/history/standard/profiles/equipment/machine.md, attributes › Act_Mode_Machine › description.

properties.name: Act_Amount_Alarm
properties.description: Number of active alarms (sim node Machine/alarms/_Count). Lifted into SMProfile-Machine in core 6.0.0 (owner 29.10.2026): CNC Act_Amount_Alarm, IMM alarmsCount.

properties.name: Act_Time_Uptime
properties.description: Machine uptime (sim node Machine/uptimeSeconds). Lifted into SMProfile-Machine in core 6.0.0 (owner 29.10.2026): IMM uptimeSeconds.

properties.name: Act_State_ShiftActive
properties.description: A shift is active on the machine (sim node Machine/typeSpecific/shiftActive). Lifted into SMProfile-Machine in core 6.0.0 (owner 29.10.2026): IMM shiftActive; the CNC's Act_Ref_Shift (the shift id) stays on the CNC.

properties.name: Act_Power_Machine
properties.description: Actual electrical power draw of the machine (sim node Machine/typeSpecific/powerKw) — a power, not an energy. Lifted into SMProfile-Machine in core 6.0.0 (owner 29.10.2026): CNC Act_Energy_Power, IMM powerKw.

properties.name: Act_Amount_LifeTime
properties.description: Lifetime counter of the machine: all parts made (partsCount/total) (sim node partsCount; owner 29.10.2026: the machine's counters stay on the machine, the quantities of one order are SegmentResponse qty_*).

properties.name: Act_Amount_LifeTimeGood
properties.description: Lifetime counter of the machine: good parts (partsCount/good) (sim node partsCount; owner 29.10.2026: the machine's counters stay on the machine, the quantities of one order are SegmentResponse qty_*).

properties.name: Act_Amount_LifeTimeScrap
properties.description: Lifetime counter of the machine: scrap parts (partsCount/scrap) (sim node partsCount; owner 29.10.2026: the machine's counters stay on the machine, the quantities of one order are SegmentResponse qty_*).

properties.name: Act_Time_Cycle
properties.description: Actual cycle time of one cycle of the machine (sim node Machine/typeSpecific/cycle/cycleTimeSec, IMM …/shot/cycleTimeSec). Lifted into SMProfile-Machine in core 6.0.0 (owner 30.10.2026): CNC Act_Time_Cycle, IMM cycleTimeSec.

properties.name: Act_State_InCycle
properties.description: The machine is in its production cycle (TRUE/FALSE) — the cycle gate of the cycle-gated rules and the trigger of the cycle-detect FSM on the edge. Lifted into SMProfile-Machine in core 6.0.0 (owner 30.10.2026): CNC Act_State_InCycle, IMM inCycle.

relationships.description: ISA-95 Part 1 role-based hierarchy: a machine is a work unit of its work center — a WorkCenter node in any work-center role (ProductionLine, audit H1; the generic WorkCenter of a job shop, X2); the role is the instance's equipmentLevel (audit M-04).

isa95.grain: one equipment element (a machine) — the class fixes NO place in the equipment hierarchy: a machine is a machine, the level is where the instance stands (owner 29.10.2026: in a ProductionLine it is a WorkCell of the line, free-standing it is a WorkUnit of its WorkCenter; sites/<site>/instances equipmentLevel = B2MML Equipment.EquipmentLevel). isa95.equipmentLevel WorkUnit is the generic work-unit level of B2MML EquipmentLevel1Type, kept only because lint-isa95 I17 / test-lint-isa95-levels need a string on the class — it claims no place. One row = one machine (CNC-Machine and InjectionMoldingMachine inherit this grain), keyed by its Equipment ID element_id — the one ID space all levels of the role-based equipment hierarchy share
isa95.mappingNote: The signals every machine shares (status, mode, alarms, uptime, shift flag, power, the lifetime part counters; core 6.0.0, owner 29.10.2026) are live machine signals. B2MML Equipment has no named field for them; a value would only sit in a generic EquipmentProperty, so they stay outside ISA-95 like the type-specific signals of CNC-Machine and InjectionMoldingMachine.
